summary: Your own input: the Context captured around your key, and the notes you write.

steps.title: Captured or written by you
steps.text: Context comes with a capture; Text holds what you write.

steps.title: Never generated
steps.text: Generation never writes or changes them.

steps.title: Context helps the other modules
steps.text: A content module reads the Context to choose the key's meaning; Text is never read.
